intro:
Id. That which differentiates a brand and makes it unique. Our challenge with Vireyes was to create its institutional image and packaging to enhance all the quality of a special meat.

When exporting quality products, identity should not be put on the back burner.

We created for Vireyes an institutional image with premium style, with a design that can be adapted to a demanding packaging with the best material and suitable to withstand food preservation conditions without damaging the packaging and that the customer or distributor receives a package to match the product.
media: Creativity, Rebranding, and Packaging for Vireyes Export Meat.
